description: Dated overview of a European data-centre market: how many data-centre projects of 500 kW or more our pipeline tracker lists and how many are permitted or being built, the facility power by stage (IT load and MVA converted, marked ≈), who develops the most of them, whether new grid connections are paused, rationed or conditional in that country, the grid carbon intensity and power price this hour, how many operating sites we track there (at least), its first three tracked projects, a dated one-sentence reading of the market with a class word for land, permitting, grid connection, power, cooling and more (words, no figures), and how many data-centre rules apply. Use for questions like "data centres in Germany", "Frankfurt data centre market", "who is building data centres in Spain".
